Keybinds:
PC:
[Scroll / Number Keys] - Switch Hands
[Q] - Hand Wheel
[Left/Right Click] - Shoot left/right hand
[Shift] - Sprint
[T] - Unlock Mouse
[F] - Flashlight
[V] - Blacklight

Controller:
[Y Button] - Switch Hands
[L1/R1] - Shoot left/right hand
[L3/Joystick Press] - Sprint
[R2] - Crouch
[Back/Select Button] - Pause Menu
[B Button] - Flashlight
